repair_1.before: in tutti i tessuti esaminati sotto stimolo meccanico o in sistema cell-autonomo la perdita di WWOX aumenta l'infiammazione
repair_1.after_landed: nei tessuti e sotto gli stimoli qui elencati la perdita di WWOX aumenta l'infiammazione
repair_1.why_resolved: The filter admitted only mechanical stimulus or cell-autonomous system and thereby excluded two of the three legs the same sentence enumerates: the cerebellar/hippocampal leg has no imposed stimulus of any class (PMID 36828035: spontaneous seizures, unchallenged cohort, LPS named only as future work) and the sepsis leg is ip LPS in a whole animal (PMID 39868255). The landed enumeration excludes neither.
repair_1.why_withdrawal_honoured: The filter wording was itself a patched survival of the retired 'not the tissue but the STIMULUS' rule — it kept a stimulus class as the discriminator with a compartment escape hatch. The landed enumeration asserts no discriminator at all, which is what a withdrawal requires, and the sources force it because the ex-vivo positive is under an INFECTIOUS stimulus (PMID 33058734 Fig. 8, asterisked on all three analytes).
repair_1.residue_a: The conjunction 'nei tessuti E sotto gli stimoli qui elencati' ranges over two enumerated sets. The tissues include lung; the stimuli include an infectious one (the sepsis leg's ip LPS). The cross-product therefore includes lung x infectious — the single measured null (Fig. 4 title: 'EC-specific WWOX KO mice do not exhibit greater BAL cytokines during LPS-induced ARDS'; Fig. 6 title the same for MRSA). The filter under-declared; the enumeration over-declares in a different cell. Mitigated, and this is why the verdict is REFINED and not INCORRECT: the exception is named in the same line immediately after, so the cross-product reading is unreachable without meeting the null.
repair_1.residue_b: 'sotto gli stimoli qui elencati' presupposes every leg has a listed stimulus. The cerebellar/hippocampal leg has none, so the second conjunct is unsatisfiable for the axis's largest and only peer-reviewed CNS positive — the same undershoot class as the filter, at reduced magnitude.
repair_1.clause_that_must_change: in ogni tessuto qui elencato la perdita di WWOX aumenta l'infiammazione — cervelletto e ippocampo senza stimolo imposto, corteccia sotto stimolo infettivo, polmone sotto stimolo meccanico — con UNA eccezione misurata: il polmone intero sotto stimolo infettivo, dove lo stesso knockout da un nullo (PMID 33058734, Figg. 4 e 6)
repair_1.note_on_the_choice: A third formulation that excludes nothing and over-claims nothing was already written down in the prior verification record. The orchestrator closed the larger undershoot by taking the weaker of the two wordings it held.

adjacent_findings_reported_not_repaired.finding: Power cannot explain the null inside PMID 33058734. The Tag's hedge 'il nullo e anche la meno potente (n=3 per braccio contro n=10)' is true across papers, but the ex-vivo POSITIVE in the same paper is at the same n = 3 and is significant on all three analytes (Fig. 8 legend).
